name: MEA Local — Extracted Shipping Service (Quarkus)
_comment: FORWARD-REFERENCE (shipping-plan.md S4+, not yet exercised by S2): points the SAME behavior-equivalence suite at the extracted Quarkus Shipping service (examples/06-shipping-service/) once it exists, on its own port so it can run side-by-side with the monolith during the strangler cutover. The collection's own 'Shipping Context Contract' folder targets {{baseUrl}}, same as every other folder — not this file directly — so it runs correctly against the monolith (:8080), the proxy (:8888), or this service's own port once it is wired in standalone. Scenario 4 (Shipping-Failure) is gated by the shippingSagaEnabled collection variable (default false) and is only meaningful once the orchestrated saga (shipping-plan S5), the monolith's orchestrated order-saga reactions (S6), and the proxy's strangler.shipping.enabled flag (S7/S8) are all wired — flip shippingSagaEnabled to true at that point. The collection itself must NOT change to target this file (that is the equivalence gate, DRQ-014); update baseUrl here (and/or point it at the Camel strangler proxy's shipping route) once S7/S8 stand the cutover up.
